extracted.intended_audience: Penn principal investigators, senior/key personnel, and research administrators preparing federal proposals
extracted.subtask_description: Institutional guidance for researchers and research administrators at the University of Pennsylvania about federal sponsor requirements and compliance steps for proposal submission and project administration (NIH, NSF, etc.).

rubrics_metrics.name: Research Security Training requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: Both the NSF and NIH have implemented new requirements for Research Security Training. All Principal Investigators and Senior/Key Personnel must complete the training within 12 months prior to the submission of a proposal.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Training must be completed within 12 months before proposal submission; Penn provides access to the required training (link: 'Access the Training Here!'). Intended to ensure investigators and key personnel meet sponsor-mandated research security training prior to applying.

rubrics_metrics.name: NIH Common Forms for Biographical Sketch and Current and Pending (Other) Support
rubrics_metrics.description: NIH will require the use of Common Forms for Biographical Sketch and Current and Pending (Other Support) generated and certified in SciENcv for proposal applications, and all progress report (RPPR), JIT, and Prior Approval submissions due on or after January 25, 2026.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Biosketch and Current and Pending/Other Support must be produced using SciENcv Common Forms and certified there; the requirement applies to new submissions, RPPRs, JIT, and Prior Approval items on/after 2026-01-25. Investigators should prepare and certify records in SciENcv ahead of deadlines.

rubrics_metrics.name: NIH data management and access requirements for controlled-access genomic data
rubrics_metrics.description: Effective January 25, 2025, users and developers of controlled-access genomic data will be required to manage that data in compliance with NIST SP 800-171 cybersecurity requirements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This represents a significant update to NIH policy on genomic data sharing; affected researchers must ensure systems and processes meet NIST SP 800-171 controls. See Penn's implementation guidance for details on meeting the cybersecurity requirements for controlled-access genomic data.

rubrics_metrics.name: NSF prohibition on participation in Malign Foreign Talent Recruitment Programs
rubrics_metrics.description: Effective May 20, 2024, the NSF has implemented a prohibition on individuals participating in Malign Foreign Talent Recruitment Programs from submitting proposals or participating in NSF-funded research.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Part of federal-wide implementation; affected individuals may be barred from proposal submission or participation in NSF-funded projects. Penn directs readers to its Research Security webpage and the new Sponsored Programs Policy for institutional details and compliance steps.
